#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# Simple AWS S3 optimizations (keeps aws s3 cp) # - Prefer many small concurrent S3 requests (helps on high-latency links) # - Use adaptive retry mode for transient throttling # - Bump timeouts so long transfers don’t fail mid-stream # - (Optional) limit bandwidth if you’re saturating the host/network export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}" # 0 = no read timeout
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
#### From the Managed Inputs Study Type should_process_type() { local t="${1,,}" [[ "$t" == "parent" || "$t" == "topmed" || "$t" == "substudy" || "$t" == "compliant" || "$t" == "imaging" ]] }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
if [[ -f review_log.txt ]]; then warn "review_log.txt present; tail:" tail -n 50 review_log.txt >&2 || true fi } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
# ----------------------------- # Assume role safely (no self-assume) # ----------------------------- already_in_role() { local role_arn="$1" local role_name role_name="$(printf '%s' "$role_arn" | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}')" local caller_arn caller_arn="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text 2>/dev/null || true)" [[ -n "$caller_arn" && "$caller_arn" == *":assumed-role/${role_name}/"* ]] }
reset_assume_role() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN }
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
reset_assume_role
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { local d="$1" rm -rf "$d" mkdir -p "$d" }
reset_workdirs() { reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing reset_dir mappings reset_dir resources reset_dir reports reset_dir logs rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/ || true }
s3_cp() { # Usage: s3_cp <src> <dst> <required:true|false> [extra aws s3 cp args...] local src="$1" dst="$2" required="${3:-true}" shift 3 || true if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors "$@"; then return 0 fi if [[ "$required" == "true" ]]; then error "S3 copy failed (required): $src -> $dst" return 1 fi warn "S3 copy failed (optional): $src -> $dst" return 0 }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need grep need wc need java need bash
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}" : "${metadata_file:?metadata_file must be set (s3://.../metadata.json)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# ----------------------------- # Init workspace # ----------------------------- reset_workdirs
# Pull managed inputs + metadata once assume_role
log "Downloading managed inputs -> data/Managed_Inputs.csv" s3_cp "$managed_inputs" "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" true
log "Downloading metadata file -> data/metadata.json" s3_cp "$metadata_file" "data/metadata.json" true
log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi" \ "data/Managed_Inputs.csv" > inputs.csv
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 10 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Per-study processing # ----------------------------- process_study() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" stdy_type="$3" data_ready="$4" data_processed="$5" has_multi="$6"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" != "yes" || "${data_processed,,}" != "no" ]]; then log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: not ready and/or already processed; skipping" return 0 fi
if ! should_process_type "$stdy_type"; then log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: type=${stdy_type} not in {parent,topmed,substudy,compliant}; skipping" return 0 fi
local abv_lc abv_uc stdy_lc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" abv_uc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
log "Processing ${stdy_id} ${abv_name} (type=${stdy_type}, multi=${has_multi})"
# clean per-study dirs but keep the top-level directories rm -rf data/* completed/* hierarchies/* processing/* mappings/* resources/* reports/* logs/* || true
# Do NOT re-assume role here (avoids self-assume AccessDenied)
# Pull study inputs assume_role log "Downloading decoded_data/${stdy_id}* -> data/" aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/" "data/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "${stdy_id}*" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors \ || { error "Failed to download decoded_data for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; }
log "Downloading mapping2.csv -> data/mapping2.csv" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/mappings/${stdy_id}/mapping2.csv" "data/mapping2.csv" true
log "Downloading PatientMapping -> data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" "data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv" true
# Build job.config cat > resources/job.config <<EOF trialid=${abv_uc} mappingfile=data/mapping2.csv patientmappingfile=data/${abv_uc}_PatientMapping.v2.csv usepatientmapping=Y EOF
# Counts (avoid pipefail killing grep when 0 matches) local pre_num pre_txt pre_num="$(grep -c "NUMERIC" data/mapping2.csv || true)" pre_txt="$(grep -c "TEXT" data/mapping2.csv || true)" log "Numeric mappings before Analyzer: ${pre_num}" log "Text mappings before Analyzer: ${pre_txt}"
log "Running DataAnalyzer" java -jar jars/DataAnalyzer.jar \ -propertiesfile resources/job.config \ -mappingskipheaders N \ -trialid "${abv_uc}" \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_data_analyzer.log" 2>&1
if [[ ! -s completed/mapping.csv ]]; then error "Expected output missing/empty: completed/mapping.csv" return 1 fi cp completed/mapping.csv data/mapping2.csv
local post_num post_txt post_num="$(grep -c "NUMERIC" data/mapping2.csv || true)" post_txt="$(grep -c "TEXT" data/mapping2.csv || true)" log "Numeric mappings after Analyzer: ${post_num}" log "Text mappings after Analyzer: ${post_txt}"
log "Running Partitioner" java -jar jars/Partitioner.jar \ -propertiesfile resources/job.config \ -mappingskipheaders N \ -trialid "${abv_uc}" \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_partitioner.log" 2>&1
log "Running runpartition.sh" bash runpartition.sh -j 8 -m 4g -c 'config.part*.config' -r resources/ \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_runpartition.log" 2>&1
log "Running MergePartitions" java -jar jars/MergePartitions.jar \ -propertiesfile resources/job.config \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_merge_partitions.log" 2>&1
if [[ ! -s "completed/${abv_uc}_allConcepts.csv" ]]; then warn "ALLCONCEPTS for ${abv_name} is empty: completed/${abv_uc}_allConcepts.csv" echo "ALLCONCEPTS for ${abv_name} (${stdy_id}) is empty!" >> review_log.txt fi
log "Uploading mapping2_post_analyzer.csv" assume_role aws s3 cp "data/mapping2.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/mappings/${stdy_id}/mapping2_post_analyzer.csv" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Uploading allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" aws s3 cp "completed/${abv_uc}_allConcepts.csv" \ "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/completed/${stdy_id}/${stdy_lc}_allConcepts_new_search_with_data_analyzer.csv" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}" }
# IMPORTANT: avoid a pipe into `while read` (prevents weird pipefail/254 errors) while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi; do # Trim quotes abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" stdy_type="${stdy_type%\"}"; stdy_type="${stdy_type#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" data_processed="${data_processed%\"}"; data_processed="${data_processed#\"}" has_multi="${has_multi%\"}"; has_multi="${has_multi#\"}"
process_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$stdy_type" "$data_ready" "$data_processed" "$has_multi" done < <(tail -n +2 inputs.csv | csvformat -U 1)
log "All studies processed"
